items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Lou McGarity trombone, and so we did about 12 concerts, Battle of Swing between Louie and Benny Goodman.

ctx.x: Well no, mostly everybody knew that about Stuff and used to come up there and sit in you know and play. Artie Dollinger was a saxophone player, later on he was on staff. He used to come in and sit and play with us all the time. Bernie Privin, come in and sit in with us. Jack Teagarden, Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy, Artie Shaw, Benny, Chris Griffin, Ziggie Elman, Allen Reuss, guitar. What's the trombone player's name, oh, he used to be with Benny. He used to come in all the time and sit in.
Lou McGarity. Lou McGarity, great trombonist Lou McGarity and what's the one that had the band? Williams.
